    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    cells = [(r,c,grid[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]]
    colors = {v for _,_,v in cells}
    counts = {v: sum(1 for _,_,x in cells if x == v) for v in colors}
    frame = max(colors, key=lambda v: counts[v])
    fill = min(colors - {frame}, key=lambda v: counts[v])
    rs = [r for r,c,v in cells]; cs = [c for r,c,v in cells]
    r0,r1,c0,c1 = min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(max(0,r0-2), min(h,r1+3)):
        for c in range(max(0,c0-2), min(w,c1+3)):
            if grid[r][c] == 0: out[r][c] = fill
    return out
');print('saved')"
